create_IMCDataset: create an IMCDataset for evaluation on IMC test sequences with given directory and img_size
get_data_IMCDataset: get a batch of images, cameras, and metadata from an IMCDataset by sequence index
calculate_crop_parameters: calculate crop parameters for an image given bbox jitter, crop dimension, and target image size
normalize_cameras_IMCDataset: normalize camera poses in an IMCDataset so they stay in a better coordinate system
adjust_camera_to_bbox_crop_: adjust camera focal length and principal point after cropping an image to a bounding box
